summary: Infantry and relic civ. Prelates inspire villagers for a fast Feudal, and relics in towers and keeps make the HRE base very hard to break. Valdy rates HRE as struggling in the current balance.
openings: Prelate inspiring 3 food and 3 gold villagers, Feudal around 2:10 to 2:15, then 7 on wood and 5 on deer with a tower.
Meinwerk Palace for Feudal games, Aachen Chapel when they fast Castle.

spikes.label: Early Men-at-Arms
spikes.detail: HRE gets Men-at-Arms in Feudal, earlier than most civs, and its infantry move faster.
spikes.answer: Ranged units with bonus damage and a tower near your gold buy time.

spikes.label: Relics in towers and keeps
spikes.detail: Castle around 10 to 12 via Regnitz Cathedral (with 3 or more relics) or Burgrave Palace. Each garrisoned relic raises a building's armor, damage and range by 25%.
spikes.answer: Contest relics as soon as Castle hits and avoid fighting under their relic towers.

scout: Meinwerk Palace means a Feudal fight
Aachen Chapel means a fast Castle
Monks heading to relics right after Castle means Regnitz Cathedral

winConditions.detail: Relics in keeps and towers, and Regnitz relic gold.

howToBeat: Use knights and crossbows against their infantry.
